def choose_move(observation):
    width = observation.get('width', 0)
    height = observation.get('height', 0)
    own_pos = observation.get('players', {}).get('own', {}).get('pos', [0, 0])
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('players', {}).get('enemies', [])
    territory_control = observation.get('territory', {}).get('owner', [])
    
    x, y = own_pos

    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Prioritize resource collection if adjacent or reachable in one step
    for r in resources:
        rx, ry = r
        dist = abs(rx - x) + abs(ry - y)
        if dist == 1:
            return [rx - x, ry - y]
        elif dist > 1:
            dx_candidate = 1 if rx > x else -1 if rx < x else 0
            dy_candidate = 1 if ry > y else -1 if ry < y else 0
            return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]

    # Pursuit or evasion: move towards or away from the nearest enemy
    # For simplicity, pursue the closest enemy
    min_dist = float('inf')
    target_enemy = None
    for enemy in enemies:
        ex, ey = enemy.get('pos', [0, 0])
        dist = abs(ex - x) + abs(ey - y)
        if dist < min_dist:
            min_dist = dist
            target_enemy = (ex, ey)
    if target_enemy:
        ex, ey = target_enemy
        dist = abs(ex - x) + abs(ey - y)
        if dist == 1:
            return [ex - x, ey - y]
        elif dist > 1:
            dx_candidate = 1 if ex > x else -1 if ex < x else 0
            dy_candidate = 1 if ey > y else -1 if ey < y else 0
            return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]
    
    # Territory control: move towards nearby unowned or enemy-controlled territory
    for idx, owner in enumerate(territory_control):
        if owner != 'own':
            tx = idx % width
            ty = idx // width
            dist = abs(tx - x) + abs(ty - y)
            if dist == 1:
                return [tx - x, ty - y]
            elif dist > 1:
                dx_candidate = 1 if tx > x else -1 if tx < x else 0
                dy_candidate = 1 if ty > y else -1 if ty < y else 0
                return [dx_candidate, dy_candidate]
    
    # No visible cues, stay put unless at boundary
    # To improve robustness, check boundaries and move inward if necessary
    move_options = []
    if x > 0:
        move_options.append([-1, 0])
    if x < width - 1:
        move_options.append([1, 0])
    if y > 0:
        move_options.append([0, -1])
    if y < height - 1:
        move_options.append([0, 1])
    # Prefer staying put if no move options
    return move_options[0] if move_options else [0, 0]
